MCEF Welcomes Peter Allen to its Advisory Board

We are ecstatic that Peter Allen has agreed to join the MCEF Advisory Board. He brings a wealth of knowledge in Marketing and Communications. He has served in the public, private, and nonprofit sector. This includes his time as Senior Assistant to San José City Councilmember Raul Peralez, Communications Coordinator for the San José Public Library Foundation, and Public Information Officer for San José Unified School District, where he directed internal and external communications for 41 schools, 4,000 employees, and 25,000 families.

He will join Founder Robert Jung, working on strategic initiatives.

A Milpitas Signature Program

Project Harmonic

Most programs stop at STEM. Project Harmonic gives every student the chance to add the A, the arts, through a signature experience offered only by the Milpitas Community Education Foundation.

  • 01

    The arts, reimagined

    Music, visual design, and creative storytelling woven directly into science and engineering projects.

  • 02

    Whole‑brain learning

    Analytical rigor paired with creative expression, so students build both technical and human skills.

  • 03

    A Milpitas original

    Designed, funded, and delivered locally. A program you will not find anywhere else in the district.

Why Harmonic is exclusive to us

Most foundations view education through the lens of STEM. We believe the arts are what turn knowledge into innovation. Project Harmonic is our promise to put the “A” back into the equation, available only to MUSD students through MCEF.

Pilot cohort · Spring 2025 · Limited seats
